pages.text: There was a good spot upstream. The water was shallow and very cool. Taro had found it yesterday.
"How do I get there?" Mumu asked. "I'll draw it for you. Go and see!"
They sat on the sandy shore, facing each other, with a wide stretch of sand between them.
Taro drew with his finger: a well, a tree, and an arrow. "From here, go this way."
Mumu looked at the drawing. From Mumu's side, the arrow pointed the other way. "Got it!"
Mumu bounded along. On and on, but no stream appeared. Only more grass.
Taro waited on the sand. Mumu grew smaller and smaller in the distance. "What's over that way?"
Mumu came back. This time, Mumu sat beside Taro to look. "Oh? The arrow points this way!"
Taro sat in Mumu's old place. The arrow really did point the opposite way. "You're right!"
They sat side by side on the same side. Now nothing was confusing. But their knees covered the whole drawing.
